## September 2026
2026-09-21  Transfer ownership of shared agents. Gemini Enterprise Admin role only
            (roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceAdmin | roles/discoveryengine.admin). Shared agents only;
            private agents cannot be transferred. Sole-owner model: new owner becomes sole owner,
            previous owner retained as agentUser. Targets = Google accounts or Workforce Identity
            Federation (WIF) principals. Schedule/event triggers are marked DISABLED by the transfer
            and must be re-enabled by the new owner.
            Doc: docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/share-custom-agents
2026-09-18  New Public Preview actions for Microsoft data stores: OneDrive (copy folder, move file,
            move folder); Outlook (create calendar, RSVP to event); SharePoint (create list item,
            share resource); Teams (add member to channel, create channel, create chat, scheduling).
2026-09-17  New online Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus subscriptions no longer include Gemini Code Assist.
2026-09-17  Voice input for the chat box GA. Admin toggle "Enable speech-to-text".
2026-09-10  Pay-as-you-go edition and AI developer tools available to all invoiced-billing projects.
2026-09-10  Gemini Enterprise app for Slack supports channel mentions and multi-turn conversations.
2026-09-09  (Breaking) VPC-SC projects cannot add website URLs as Gemini Notebook Enterprise sources.
2026-09-08  Semantic search for agent discovery in Google Cloud Marketplace.
2026-09-04  Monday federated data store connection GA (boards, items, updates, docs; no ingestion).
2026-09-04  Projects in Gemini Enterprise — dedicated knowledge bases, private file uploads, chat.
2026-09-03  Observability views: Latency (p50/p95) and Error rate (by response class and error code).
2026-09-02  Workflow Builder (formerly Agent Designer) GA — multi-step workflows, scheduled execution,
            manual triggering, Slack/Jira/ServiceNow integration.
2026-09-02  Gemini 3.8 Flash GA in Global, US, EU.
2026-09-01  Overage controls available to all invoiced-billing projects.

WATCH: connector LIST stays static while ACTION SETS grow (8/21, 8/30, 9/02, 9/18). Diff actions, not connectors.
